title: John Harbaugh on Cam Skattebo leaving practice: Just working through the football shape part of it

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: John Harbaugh on Cam Skattebo leaving practice: Just working through the football shape part of it
sources.description: Running back Cam Skattebo made an early exit from Friday's practice, but Giants head coach John Harbaugh didn't show much concern about his condition after the workout.
